top_signals.title: Adani Firms Settle Disclosure Norms Probe by Indian Regulator
top_signals.summary: Billionaire Gautam Adani’s group firms settled one of the probes into a US short-seller’s accusations, further easing regulatory overhang for the ports-to-power conglomerate.
